scripts.sync:android: cp main/index.html main/style.css main/script.js main/admin.js www/ && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p releases && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk releases/ParticleRNG-debug.apk
scripts.build:all: npm run sync:android && npm run package:mac && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p releases && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk releases/ParticleRNG-debug.apk
